MUD LOSS at 3,790 m MD (SYLHET) | Severity: CRITICAL | NPT: 52.0 hrs | MW: 11.9 ppg
Total loss of returns at 3,790 m MD in fractured Sylhet limestone; loss rate exceeded 120 bbl/hr.
Standpipe pressure dropped 380 psi. Well kept full with water while LCM was mixed.
Mitigation: Reduced mud weight by 0.3 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone;
cured after two attempts.
Lesson: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Sylhet loss zone; stage
cross-linked pills before drilling into the limestone.

Flow observed on connection at 3,804 m MD (Sylhet) after losses reduced hydrostatic head; 9 bbl
gain. Well shut in with SIDPP 310 psi.
Mitigation: Flow-checked, closed BOP, circulated influx out and increased MW to 12.6 ppg with
kill-line monitoring.
Lesson: Narrow window in Sylhet: manage ECD carefully to avoid losses while holding the kick off.
